gaps.sentence: ___ the second half begin than the rain returned.
gaps.explanation: No sooner did the second half begin than… — inversion with do-support.

gaps.sentence: ___ I known about the deadline, I would have hurried.
gaps.explanation: Had I known = If I had known — inversion replaces 'if'.

gaps.sentence: Barely ___ the survey published when the complaints arrived.
gaps.explanation: Barely had X happened when Y — like hardly… when.

gaps.sentence: ___ it not been for your help, we would have failed.
gaps.explanation: Had it not been for = if it hadn't been for — fixed inverted conditional.

gaps.sentence: ___ you stands the man responsible for the discovery.
gaps.explanation: Dramatic inversion: 'Before you stands the man…' — the phrase of place is fronted and the verb precedes the subject.

gaps.sentence: Should you ___ any problems, call reception immediately.
gaps.explanation: Should you experience… = If you experience… — formal conditional inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only when the audit was complete ___ the accounts released.
gaps.explanation: Only when X happened were the accounts released — inversion after only when.

gaps.sentence: At no point ___ the pilot leave the cockpit.
gaps.explanation: At no point did… = never did… — negative adverbial inversion.
